styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: monochrome black and white, pure black primary, white background, gray scale neutrals

visualQualityCheckpoints.description: Pure black (#000) on white (#fff) primary color relationship; all accents use gray scale only
visualQualityCheckpoints.observableTarget: Primary action buttons and active states use pure black; no colored accents (no blue, green, red etc.)

visualQualityCheckpoints.description: Clear typographic hierarchy with at least 3 distinct levels; dense but readable
visualQualityCheckpoints.observableTarget: Page title (large/bold), section headers (medium), body text (regular), secondary text (small/gray)

visualQualityCheckpoints.description: Space-efficient mobile layout with minimal padding, content prioritized over chrome
visualQualityCheckpoints.observableTarget: Horizontal padding 16px or less; list items compact; cards use borders not heavy shadows

visualQualityCheckpoints.description: Tailwind utility classes + CSS variables; static HTML, no framework dependencies
visualQualityCheckpoints.observableTarget: Uses inline SVG icons; bottom nav fixed at 56px; document-scroll viewport

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean feed-style home page with status bar, app header, horizontal scroll categories, and vertical content list. Monochrome aesthetic with strong typographic hierarchy.
continuityAnchors: Monochrome black and white color system
componentPlan: App header with title and action icons
Content card list (with thumbnail + title + meta)

pages.title: 发现
